title: FleetForge v2.6.3 Enterprise IT Edition
changelog: Minimize to Windows System Tray (NotifyIcon) with interactive controls and background task awareness
Windows 11 Fluent Toaster Notification popup showing live progress and completion summary (Selected, Installed, Downloaded, Status)
Windows 11 colorful Fluent icon badges across navigation rail and pack cards
Bottom bar Stop button during setup and smart Finish button returning to originating screen
Relocated install-log.txt, error-log.txt, and session data to AppData\Local\FleetForge with complete purge on uninstall
Removed HTML report generation and blocking modal dialogs for a seamless deployment experience
